# Rhetorical rhythm

Résumé 🙂.

PostgreSQL is the primary target, and this page is the map of what Ptah manages <!-- want "filler.document-metadiscourse" -->
beyond portable table DDL.

## Reframing

PostgreSQL does not keep the declaration. It stores the parsed form. <!-- want "syntax.repeated-reframing" -->
The reader does not copy the text. It prints the stored form.

## Abstract judgment

That is a boundary rather than a missing feature. <!-- want "filler.evaluative-closure" -->

## Offline

**Offline, the declaration is the evidence.** <!-- want "filler.evaluative-closure" -->

The declaration selects the extension when no live catalog is available.

## Technical counterexamples

The declaration is the evidence for the model selected in this run.
The checksum is a constraint rather than a preference.
This page is a map of Europe.
The server keeps the declaration; the client stores the parsed form.
The example preserves its wording: `That is a boundary rather than a missing feature.`
